title: Filesystem
description: Follow the administrator’s handover through a real Linux filesystem.

challenges.title: Hidden in the handover
challenges.goal: Find the hidden maintenance note in your documents directory.
hints: Use pwd to check where you are. ls normally hides names starting with a dot.
Try ls -la ~/documents, then use cat to read the hidden note.

challenges.title: A line in the logs
challenges.goal: The handover names an event in /var/log/portal/maintenance.log. Find its flag.
hints: grep searches a text file for a word or phrase; less lets you browse it.

challenges.title: The previous administrator
challenges.goal: Inspect the history file, become root with the planted credential, and read /root/flag.txt.
hints: Find hidden files in your home directory. The planted history is .bash_history; your ongoing history is stored separately.
Use su - to become root. Password input is intentionally not echoed. id shows your current user.

challenges.title: Close the incident
challenges.goal: Follow /root/closure-note.txt to the matching inventory record.
hints: /root is root’s home; / is the filesystem root.
